steps.en: Install the published package and start the local proxy
steps.zh: 安装发布包，启动本地代理

steps.en: Point the client base URL at the proxy with your intended upstream
steps.zh: 把客户端请求地址指向代理，保留目标上游

steps.en: Continue the coding conversation through the routed client
steps.zh: 通过已接入的客户端继续编码会话

steps.en: Offer context tools and apply accepted range summaries
steps.zh: 提供上下文工具，应用被接受的区间摘要

steps.en: Forward the working conversation while keeping stored originals retrievable
steps.zh: 转发工作对话，并让已存原文保持可取回

value.en: Selected history ranges become summaries instead of resending every original message
value.zh: 选定历史区间用摘要代替，不必每轮重发全部原文
